notes.title: 1st birthday of NeonFlight
notes.content:
[h1]1st birthday of NeonFlight[/h1]

Hello dear community,

[b]NeonFlight is now 1 year old[/b]. We are very sorry that NeonFlight only got 1 update since release, but we want to thank the people who gave the game a chance and bought it. 

It is still [b]unclear[/b] how the future of NeonFlight looks like, but we could make great progress as a publisher through this project. As a publisher we have recognized our mistakes and will do better next time. We are looking forward to new projects coming up.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1
notes.content:
The new main menu is now common in NeonFlight and gives you the possibility to adjust the volume of your music from 1-10 freely. The highscore bar has been revised and is now visible in the game in the upper right corner. With the new patch you can now make a direct click to try again. Or simply go to the menu back...
Have fun with the new update!
